cd /opt/trading-bot/positions_regr; date -u; echo MODE; cat tg_mode.json; echo; echo WATCH; python3 -c "
import json,time
W=json.load(open('tg_watch.json'));now=time.time()*1000
for x in W['items'][-12:]: print(x['id'],x['sym'],x['side'],x.get('line'),x['status'],x.get('reason'),'age_min',round((now-x['created'])/60000),'end_min_ago',round((now-x['t_end'])/60000) if x.get('t_end') else None)
"; echo OUTBOX; tail -6 tg_outbox.jsonl | cut -c1-200; echo CHANLOG; tail -8 chan.log | cut -c1-200; grep -c "cycle error" chan.log; systemctl is-active chan-orders-regr tg-bot-regr; journalctl -u chan-orders-regr -n 5 --no-pager | cut -c1-200
